description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures,  we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

 

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

About the Role

  • We’re looking for a Customer Success Associate (CSA) to join our Velocity team – where CaptivateIQ delivers customer outcomes and value at scale. You’ll help a base of 300+ customers get measurably more value from CaptivateIQ by spotting what’s happening in their accounts early, and guiding them to the right resources, recommendations, and advice at the right moment – before a quiet account turns into a renewal risk.

    This is not a named book-of-business or renewals role. Your focus is derisking accounts, detecting signals, and driving customer outcomes. The best Velocity CSAs are value detectives who are laser focused on execution at scale. You’ll use data signals and efficient, high-quality customer conversations to understand which outcomes each customer cares about, segment customers accordingly, and run programs for each segment that move them along their “Golden Path” – the recommended journey to recognizing value with CaptivateIQ. You’ll do it through a mix of 1:many communications (in-app, email, Slack, webinars), group office hours, and targeted live calls where a human conversation makes the difference.

    You’ll work from a prioritized queue of tasks and plays in our customer success platform (ChurnZero), driven by what the data tells us to do next. You’ll also work to automate and improve the reactive work that exists today, so that more of your time goes to proactive outreach and campaign development. Velocity is evolving quickly, and you’ll execute plays consistently while giving feedback that helps us improve them as the segment strategy evolves.

    If you’re curious, organized, comfortable with high-volume work, and energized by the idea of building scaled programs that make a measurable difference to customers, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Be a value detective: Use data signals (product usage, seat utilization, admin activity, health score, sentiment, support and survey responses) and efficient insight collection to understand each customer’s goals, identify gaps in value, and properly segment the Velocity portfolio.

  • Execute methodically around signals: Prioritize your day around tasks and plays in ChurnZero that signals trigger, and quickly execute the associated actions based on what the data tells you.

  • Capture outcomes and sentiment: Validate customer-stated outcomes and keep account data, sentiment, contacts, and risk records accurate so that programs, risk reviews, and teammates can rely on them.

  • Identify and mitigate risk early: Derisking accounts is the core of this role. Detect risk through early signals, document it in risk records, and run mitigation plays well ahead of renewal, working with the Renewals Manager on accounts approaching the renewal stage. Give feedback that helps evolve the automated plays that catch risk sooner.

  • Run programs by segment: Execute plays and campaigns for each customer segment and outcome that drive increasing value from CaptivateIQ over time, with consistent, high-quality follow-through.

  • Drive adoption along the Golden Path: Guide customers to the features, configurations, and best practices that map to their stated outcome in our Value Framework, partnering closely with our Value Engineer and Education teams.

  • Scale through multi-channel communication: Create and deploy 1:many programmatic communications – in-app messages, email, Slack, webinars, and cohort-based adoption campaigns – that connect customers to the right resources at the right time.

  • Connect live where it counts: Host group office hours and run targeted live outreach to customers who need a human conversation, such as new admins, low-adoption accounts, and customers working toward a new outcome.

  • Manage the inbound queue efficiently: Work customer questions and requests through a queue-based, round-robin model with consistent quality and response times, and flag the patterns that should be automated or self-served back to Product, Education and Support.

  • Support renewals and upsells: Partner with the Velocity Renewals Manager and Customer Success Manager, who own renewals. Provide the risk, outcome, and adoption context they need, and help identify seat and service expansion opportunities by connecting customers to the next best step for their business.

  • Help shape the playbook: Give feedback on which signals, plays, and messages work and which are noisy. Spot patterns across accounts and turn them into improvements to the Velocity segment strategy. Stay aware of the competitive landscape and flag competitor threats you see in customer conversations.

  • Use AI to scale your impact: Integrate AI tools and agents into your daily workflow, from account research and analysis to drafting outreach and automating routine tasks.

  • Be the voice of the customer: Partner with Product, Support, Professional Services, and Education to surface Velocity customer feedback and trends.

What You'll Bring

  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing or prospect-facing role, ideally one with high-volume outreach and clear structure, such as Scaled Customer Success, Business Development, Support, or SMB Account Management.

  • Comfort working from a shared queue and a round-robin approach to inbound customer communication, with consistent quality and responsiveness.

  • Ability to prioritize and structure your own day around tasks, plays, and signals in a CS platform or CRM, and to act on what the data tells you.

  • Analytical, curious mindset: you enjoy digging into data to understand why a customer is or isn’t getting value, and you can turn what you find into a clear next step.

  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to write clear, concise, and engaging outreach, and confidence in live calls with customers of all seniority levels.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you work well within set parameters, and stay flexible and resourceful when you run into a scenario that doesn’t have a play yet.

  • Proactive, ownership-driven mindset: you notice what needs to be done and do it, and you look for ways to automate or improve repetitive work.

  • Eagerness to learn a technical, finance-adjacent product and to use AI tools to work more effectively.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a scaled or low-touch customer segment.

  • Experience running email or digital campaigns, webinars, or office hours.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, ChurnZero (or a similar CS platform), Gong, or Front.

  • Exposure to incentive compensation management (ICM), sales performance management (SPM), or finance and revenue operations personas.

  • Experience with renewals or commercial conversations. Familiarity with SaaS pricing models is a plus.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.

  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.

  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.

  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.

  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.

  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.

  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

CaptivateIQ participates in E-Verify, web-based system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the eligibility of their employees to work in the United States
